goal: Write the test runner config file for a Node library: global test APIs, a setup file, a 10 second per-test timeout, V8 coverage with text and HTML reports and an 80% line threshold.
Write a test runner config that runs tests in child processes instead of threads, forces every test file to run one at a time in a single worker, and retries failed tests twice on CI.
Write a test runner config with two named groups of tests: unit tests that run in Node, and component tests that run in a real headless Chromium browser driven by Playwright.
Write a test file that replaces one function of node:fs with a fake while keeping the rest of the real module, and asserts on how the fake was called.
Write a test file for a debounce function: control time manually, advance it, pin the current date, and assert the callback fired exactly once.

Write a test file that spies on a method of an object, makes it resolve a canned value, asserts it was called once with given arguments, stubs an environment variable and a global, and cleans all of that up after each test.
Write a test file that waits for an eventually-true condition by retrying an assertion, checks a function throws an error matching a pattern, checks a promise rejects, and uses an inline snapshot.

Write a test file with a table-driven test over several input rows, a test that is skipped when running on CI, a per-test timeout and retry count, and a compile-time assertion about a function's return type.
